name: Amazon ElastiCache CacheCluster
description: Schema representing an Amazon ElastiCache cache cluster, which is a collection of cache nodes running Redis or Memcached cache engine software.

CacheClusterId.description: The user-supplied identifier of the cluster. This identifier is a unique key that identifies a cluster.

ARN.description: The ARN (Amazon Resource Name) of the cache cluster.

CacheClusterStatus.description: The current state of this cluster.

Engine.description: The name of the cache engine used in this cluster.

EngineVersion.description: The version of the cache engine that is used in this cluster.

CacheNodeType.description: The name of the compute and memory capacity node type for the cluster.

NumCacheNodes.description: The number of cache nodes in the cluster.

PreferredAvailabilityZone.description: The name of the Availability Zone in which the cluster is located or "Multiple" if the cache nodes are located in different Availability Zones.

CacheClusterCreateTime.description: The date and time when the cluster was created.

PreferredMaintenanceWindow.description: Specifies the weekly time range during which maintenance on the cluster is performed.

CacheSubnetGroupName.description: The name of the cache subnet group associated with the cluster.

CacheParameterGroup.description: Status of the cache parameter group.

CacheParameterGroupName.description: The name of the cache parameter group.

CacheNodeIdsToReboot.description: A list of the cache node IDs which need to be rebooted.

CacheNodes.description: A list of cache nodes that are members of the cluster.

CacheNodeStatus.description: The current state of this cache node.

CacheNodeCreateTime.description: The date and time when the cache node was created.

Address.description: The DNS hostname of the cache node.

Port.description: The port number that the cache engine is listening on.

ParameterGroupStatus.description: The status of the parameter group applied to this cache node.

CustomerAvailabilityZone.description: The Availability Zone where this node was created and now resides.

ConfigurationEndpoint.description: Represents a Memcached cluster endpoint which can be used by an application to connect to any node in the cluster.

Address.description: The DNS hostname of the cache node.

Port.description: The port number that the cache engine is listening on.

SecurityGroups.description: A list of VPC Security Groups associated with the cluster.

SecurityGroupId.description: The identifier of the cache security group.

Status.description: The status of the cache security group membership.

ReplicationGroupId.description: The replication group to which this cluster belongs.

SnapshotRetentionLimit.description: The number of days for which ElastiCache retains automatic cluster snapshots.

SnapshotWindow.description: The daily time range (in UTC) during which ElastiCache begins taking a daily snapshot of your cluster.

AutoMinorVersionUpgrade.description: If true, then minor version patches are applied automatically.

Port.description: The port number on which each of the cache nodes accepts connections.

NotificationConfiguration.description: Describes a notification topic and its status.

TopicArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that identifies the topic.

TopicStatus.description: The current state of the topic.

TransitEncryptionEnabled.description: A flag that enables in-transit encryption when set to true.

AtRestEncryptionEnabled.description: A flag that enables encryption at rest when set to true.
